description: This file defines extension methods for the ShellScope class, providing functionalities such as registering callbacks before disposal, adding deferred signals and tasks, and handling exceptions within the scope.

classes.name: ShellScopeExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ShellScope to manage disposal callbacks, deferred signals, tasks, and exception handling.

methods.name: RegisterBeforeDispose
methods.description: Registers a delegate task or action to be invoked before the shell scope is disposed, with optional ordering.

methods.name: AddDeferredSignal
methods.description: Adds a signal to be sent just before the scope is disposed.

methods.name: AddDeferredTask
methods.description: Schedules a task or action to be executed in a new scope after the current scope is disposed.

methods.name: AddExceptionHandler
methods.description: Adds a handler to be invoked if an exception occurs during execution within the scope.
